eur100_executability.note: prices are the last closes in the data (2025-12-31); the sandbox has no route to live quotes. Binary long-or-flat needs no granularity, so only openability binds.

definitions.1_reporting: capital-matched benchmark and uncapped B&H BTC present on every report
definitions.2_shuffle: main OOS Sharpe - shuffled OOS Sharpe >= 0.4
definitions.3_degradation: main OOS Sharpe / mean selected IS Sharpe > 0.5
definitions.4_excess: main concatenated OOS excess vs CAPITAL-MATCHED benchmark > 0
definitions.5_windows: criterion 4 holds in >= 2 of 3 window configurations
definitions.6_stability: <30% of transitions move a parameter >2 grid steps — VACUOUS on a 3x2x2 grid (no axis can move >2 steps); reported descriptively, contributes nothing to PASS

overall.rule: PASS requires criteria 2, 3, 4, 5 on BOTH pairs; 6 is vacuous; 1 is reporting
